children: The following are significant news stories, press reports and events on Wednesday. ALL TIMES GMT (Poland: GMT + 2 hours):

In December 2026, Polish President Karol Nawrocki will meet with U.S. President Donald Trump during the G20 summit in Miami, said Marcin Przydacz, minister in the presidential office, in an interview with Rzeczpospolita daily.
National Bank of Poland (NBP) Governor Adam Glapinski said during the G20 meeting that Polish monetary policy must be flexible and data-driven.
The NBP does not commit to a specific interest rate path; it analyzes incoming information, forecasts, and the balance of risks and makes decisions based on that, he added.
A fire at a Polish drone factory was likely caused by sabotage, Poland's interior minister said on Tuesday.
Polish video games maker CD Projekt's
second-quarter net profit is expected to rise 38% from a year earlier as discounts on its "Cyberpunk 2077" and "Phantom Liberty" games boosted results, a Reuters poll showed on Tuesday.
said on Tuesday it had notified prosecutors over alleged safety breaches during the 2023 launch of its flagship Polimery Police project.

Poland's manufacturing sector contracted for a 16th straight month in August, while Hungarian factory output also weakened, but the Czech manufacturing business sentiment jumped to a more than four-year high on strong output and orders.
